name: What makes a drywall patch look invisible instead of obvious?

mainEntity.name: What makes a drywall patch look invisible instead of obvious?

acceptedAnswer.text: Good results depend on matching the wall texture, smoothing the edges, and using the right paint sheen. A repair can still show if the patch is too thick, the sanding is uneven, or the final coat doesn’t blend with surrounding paint.
acceptedAnswer.description: A nearly invisible repair comes down to smooth sanding, careful feathering, and matching the wall texture and paint. Poor blending is what usually makes patches stand out.
